title: Forest Ledger — operable-proxy integration QA
allocation_caveat: The operable-proxy intensity screen uses SCANFI merchantable area intersected with a share-based 2016 tenure proxy, not a THLB. It has no slope, road access, age/disturbance, growth, yield, or economic content. 150 Mm3 is conditional: the 1.0 m3/ha/yr per-province screen is infeasible by 16.296 Mm3, and the 1.2 screen is still short by 4.492 Mm3 because BC, ON, YT, and NT documented caps bind below 1.2 x operable area. The national operable envelope alone would clear 150 Mm3 at 1.2. 119 Mm3 passes both. The LP allocation is a comparison/screening result, not a legal AAC, enforced provincial constraint, or policy frontier.
